text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nghahhh! So many waifus w-wishingme a happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to remember all of it so bad<n>I've barely
blinked! Ahh, my<n>memory's fried! I can't!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-are you all right? Do you feel sick?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I think she feels overwhelmed. Must<n>be a case of
my aura shining too<n>bright...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
AHH! It's the peak ship! I mean, hey<n>Doto and
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just fine. Nothing to worry<n>about! I was just
running a liiittle over<n>capacity for a bit!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Not sure I understand,<n>but... Ah, I
know!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall gift you a few words in my<n>silvery voice!
That ought to<n>reinvigorate you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-oh no! Sh-she's become a statue!
